dates.what_en: Debtor paid AED 120,000 by bank transfer
Cheque no. 004512 returned unpaid, insufficient funds
Formal notice issued through the notary public
Notice served on the debtor (handwritten note)
Hearing before the Second Major Commercial Circuit (handwritten note)

deadlines.what_en: Pay within 15 days of receiving the notice (received 3 Sep 2026); passed without payment

claims.item_en: Delay interest at 6% a year from each invoice's due date until full payment (agreed in clause 9)
Court fees, costs and lawyer's fees

key_facts.fact_en: Total invoiced AED 506,500; paid AED 120,000; balance AED 386,500
Cheque no. 004512 for AED 150,000 bounced and does not count as payment
The parties agreed delay interest of 6% a year in clause 9 of the supply agreement
On the statement of account the printed balance 380,500 is struck through and corrected by hand to 386,500, with initials; the corrected figure matches the notice and the claim
